title: Portuguese Pastel de Nata Custard Tarts
hookLine: Shattering puff pastry spirals cradling silky lemon-cinnamon vanilla custard with caramelized blisters.

items.name: Whole milk + 4 egg yolks + 1/2 cup sugar + 2 tbsp cornstarch

steps.title: Set Up Heavy Saucepan & Ingredients
steps.instructionTemplate: Place a heavy-bottomed saucepan over medium-low heat and have a heatproof silicone whisk ready. Measure out {puff_pn} and {custard_pn} and {cinn_pn} in advance—stovetop desserts move fast once they start bubbling.

steps.title: Roll Puff & Press Muffin Cups
steps.instructionTemplate: Roll {puff_pn} into a tight log, slice 12 rounds, and press swirls up the sides of a muffin tin. Keep {puff_pn} prepped and measured within reach so each step comes together smoothly and evenly.

steps.title: Simmer Custard & Bake at 475°F
steps.instructionTemplate: Whisk {custard_pn} infused with {cinn_pn} until thick, fill pastry cups, and bake at 475°F (245°C) for 13–14 mins until blistered.
steps.creatorSecret: High oven heat creates the authentic caramelized blister spots without drying the custard.

steps.title: Remove from Heat, Cool & Serve
steps.instructionTemplate: Pull the pan off the heat as soon as Portuguese Pastel de Nata Custard Tarts coats the spoon thickly. Let cool slightly so the glaze or custard thickens even more, then spoon into 12 bowls and garnish before serving.

ugcQuotes.quote: Turned out bakery-grade on my first try! Ready in 26 mins.
